author: Caroline Rapp
text: Mike is so kind and knowledgeable! I moved into a new place and the bathtub drain was clogged. He came out right away and fixed it so quickly. He was very generous with sharing his knowledge too. Highly recommend!

author: Chris Jimenez
text: Mike took care of the problems at my daughter’s house. He’s a pleasure to deal with and very affordable. I would recommend him to anyone who has plumbing issues.

author: Whitney Johnson
text: At the beginning of May my basement toilet stopped working. I called a plumber out & they spent an hour trying to fix it before saying they couldn’t get it & had to come back the following week with a longer tool. I waited about a month for them to reach out & reschedule a time for them to come back & never heard from them. I called Becks plumbing who referred me to this wonderful guy who was able to squeeze me in that same day on his way home. He was downstairs for about a min or 2 & came up asking if our power had recently been shut off & proceeded to show me that all I needed to do was hit a rest button & it was back up & working. He stayed a few extra mins to vacuum up all the water that had come out onto the floor & left. Didn’t charge me a penny. Super nice, professional, & helpful. Highly recommend!! Thank you for your help!

author: Elizabeth Griffin
text:
Mike at The Drain Pro’s was absolutely outstanding! From start to finish, he was professional, punctual, and incredibly knowledgeable. He quickly diagnosed the issue, explained everything clearly, and made sure I understood my options before getting started.

The work was done efficiently and with great attention to detail — and he left everything clean and in perfect condition. It’s not often you find someone who combines skill, honesty, and excellent customer service the way Mike does.

If you need drain or plumbing help, I highly recommend Mike at The Drain Pro’s. Five stars all the way!

author: Patricia Englebert
text: Mike was on time, polite and professional.  He solved my 10 year drain problém in less than an hour and when he left everything was left spotless!  I will definitely call him again if I ever have another issue and I will be giving his contact information to everyone that I know.  Thank you, Mike, for your excellent customer service and your professional knowledge!
